notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Makes the Pursuit level much more forgiving.
[*] Improves collisions on several types of platforms.
[*] Improves visuals for the ending.
[*] Adds several missing translations.
[*] Reworks options menu.
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent certain levels from ending properly (such as Sacrifice).
[*] General bug fixes.
[*] Adds a loading spinner.
[*] Removed cheese...
[/list]

notes.title: Bigger and Better
notes.content:
Hey you Handsome Dragons! Jack here, Creative Director of Handsome Dragon Games, in case you forgot since last time. Anyway, I’m here to give you the rundown on our latest update for Dyadic! We’ve got a lot of new improvements being made, and a new Demo too! On top of that, Dyadic is also in even more languages now!

First and foremost, we’ve completely overhauled the game’s control system. Well, the back-end at least. This means that you’ll never have to worry about what kind of controller you’re using again. They’ve all been streamlined and integrated so all you need to do is choose if you’re using one or two (or just a keyboard).

What’s more, you won’t have to worry about certain controllers having weird and unexpected configurations. No more ‘triangle to walk left’ or ‘left trigger to pause’ nonsense. When you play the game, you play it the same on all controllers. Simple as that.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/CGEcvdf.png][/img]
[i]Playstation, Xbox, or weird third-party - this scheme’s got you covered.[/i]

Not only that, but we’ve got a whole series of fixes and improvements that’ll make your life easier and better than ever - whilst you’re playing Dyadic, at least. The flow and functionality of menus have been improved, controls, tutorials, and interactions have been tightened up, mirrors have been polished to an impeccable sheen, and moving platforms are no longer devious statue-stealing demons.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/PrbBjuv.png][/img]
[i]In your hands or on the ground, our improved mirrors outshine their previous selves.[/i]

[img=http://i.imgur.com/FlxgiAE.png][/img]
[i]Our tutorial prompts are as informative and ever, and even more responsive![/i]

[img=http://i.imgur.com/BdO4pqz.gif][/img]
[i]No longer will the statue be stolen from your very hands. Not by moving platforms, at least.[/i]

And then there’s even more, ‘The Finale’ can now be played straight from the Level Select. That means no more running through the last level of Zone 3 to get there every time (meaning getting all those achievements just became that much easier).

[img=http://i.imgur.com/r04rZKy.png][/img]
[i]So important it even gets its own Zone header.[/i]

For any of our European fans, we’ve added a whole host of localisation options for the game, namely new languages. So if you’d rather be playing the game in German, French, Swedish, or Dutch, we’ve got you covered now!

Lastly, for all of you who still aren’t sure if Dyadic is the kind of game you really want to play, we’ve made a new demo featuring a couple of levels from the game for you try out! And for those that know us, don’t worry, this is the last one. That demo will be live very soon, we’ll make another quick post once it’s up. Don’t miss it!

Now if you haven’t tried Dyadic out yet, you’ve got no excuse not to!

[img=http://i.imgur.com/pXiBJda.png][/img]
[i]Come on, grab a friend and see who comes out on top![/i]

Until next time,
Jack

notes.title: Now Available for Mac!
notes.content:
Hey there you Handsome People! Big news today!
Dyadic is now available on Mac! It's been a long time coming, but we've finally managed to work out all the kinks, and it's ready for you to play!

What's more, to celebrate, Dyadic is 20% off on all platforms this weekend! Mac users, enjoy!

notes.title: Dyadic is in French!
notes.content:
Today we have launched French for our game! This is a big step for us since while developing we had no intention of translating the game. It was thanks to an awesome user who approached us and offered to translate the game that made us want to do it.

At the moment, we have only released French. However, if you are interested in helping out translate the game for other languages, shoot us a message and we will be sure to reply shortly. 

We also fixed a few bugs this patch including one that was making it impossible to pass 1-6. We sincerely apologise for that issue, and we made sure to fix it quickly. 

On another note, the Level Editor for Dyadic is coming along and will be our next major patch. Half the team is still working on that while we are touching up an old project we made during a 48hour Game Jam. 

It's an exciting time for Handsome Dragon Games, and we love hearing feedback and suggestions for all the community. If you ever want to get in touch, we will always be happy to reply.

Thanks for taking the time to read!

- Handsome Dragon Games Team

Our support email for things such as bugs and issues support@handsomedragongames.com
